records.name: Wissinoming Park
records.summary: A Friends group for Wissinoming Park in the Northeast, as the City lists it. We could not reach its website or find any recent activity, so we do not yet know what it does.
records.what_you_do: We have not confirmed what this group does. The City's stewardship office can connect you with the group.

first_step.how: Email Parks and Recreation's stewardship office (pprstewardship@phila.gov) and ask to be connected with this Friends group

records.notes: The City list gives https://www.wissinomingpark.org as the group's website. Both that address and https://wissinomingpark.org failed to resolve (DNS lookup failed) on 2026-10-08, so no website is recorded. The City list email is the stewardship office, so it is not used as a group contact. The City list name is Wissinoming Park; the group's own name was not confirmed. The City list entry came from the batch file and was not re-fetched. Search budget went to the groups with no website at all, so this group got no search. Worth re-checking before publishing.

records.name: The Neighbors Garden at Hatfield House
records.summary: A neighbors' garden group that the City lists at the Hatfield House in East Fairmount Park. We could not find its own website or any recent activity.
records.what_you_do: We have not confirmed what this group does.

first_step.how: Email neighborsgardenphilly@gmail.com, the address the City lists for this group, and ask how to join the garden

records.notes: One search and one 2026 City article about Hatfield House found nothing about a garden group there. The Fairmount Park Conservancy runs the house, and an arts group held events there in past years. Neither is this group, so neither is recorded as a contact. The category gardening-greening comes from the name only. The email comes from the City list alone and was not confirmed on any other page, so check it before relying on it.
